sources.entry: Swetrix - Web analytics which track your site's traffic, monitor your site's speed, analyse user sessions and pageflows, see the user flows and more (alternative to Google Analytics). (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Docker-based self-hosting setup for Swetrix, a cookieless, privacy-focused web analytics tool positioned as an alternative to Google Analytics.
summary.what_it_does: This repository contains the deployment setup for self-hosting Swetrix, an open source web analytics platform. The README describes Swetrix as a cookieless, privacy-focused alternative to Google Analytics and a lightweight tool. The setup uses a configure.sh script that prompts for values (including BASE_URL) and generates a .env file, then docker compose starts the services. The web portal is then reachable at the URL set in BASE_URL. The README is partly truncated, so the full list of analytics features is not confirmed here; the awesome-selfhosted listing mentions traffic tracking, site speed monitoring, session analysis and user flows. A more detailed guide is referenced on the project's documentation site.
how_to_run: Install Docker if you haven't already.
Run ./configure.sh to set environment variables (including BASE_URL) and generate a .env file
Open the Swetrix web portal at the URL set in BASE_URL
notable: Interactive configure.sh script generates the .env file for you
Single docker compose command starts all services
Points to a separate step-by-step self-hosting guide in the docs
caveats: README is truncated, so some setup details and the full feature list are not visible
Requires Docker and Docker Compose on the host
Configuration reference is linked rather than included in the README
